sections.advice: back through Abric del Barranc d'en Cabrera → La Covassa is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-la-covassa-abric-del-mas-de-barbe.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-la-covassa-abric-del-mas-de-barbe.story: From Culla it runs 313 km to Culla; allow about 5 h 24 of riding. On the way it passes Abric del Barranc d'en Cabrera, Galeria del Roure, Las Rozas I and Abric del mas de Barberà. The highest point is about 1,250 m. The line favours views over speed.

swietokrzyskie-hills-road.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Świętokrzyskie Hills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 58 km this is Świętokrzyskie Hills Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Świętokrzyskie Hills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 14.0%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Świętokrzyskie Hills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 48 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

swietokrzyskie-hills-road.story: From Kielce it runs 112 km to Opatów; allow about 2 h 09 of riding. The climb of the day is Święty Krzyż. The line favours views over speed.
